KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: The values themselves are right: all 16 canonical and 14 boundary writes print in full and land on their own measured rules. The FAIL is that the delivered participant guide contradicts itself about one of them and misdescribes what the participant received. participant-instructions.md line 33 says the packet wrote 'your name, date of birth, case number, street address, city, state and ZIP on the proposed order'. Its later section 'What the platform deliberately left blank' then says: 'The State line at section 1 of the order. The rule Colorado draws there is 31 points wide ... and this packet writes your city and your ZIP on either side of it. Write your state on it yourself.' In the delivered canonical bytes that line is NOT blank: reports/actual-writes.json records defendant-state drawn as 'CO' at rect x 393.93 y 380.38 w 27.25, pdftotext reads 'City: Denver State: CO Zip Code: 80202', and I counted 84 added ink pixels inside that rect in the rendered page. The family's own byte proof agrees with the bytes and against the guide: blanks-left-for-the-participant.json nearMissesRefusedByRole records 'This build narrows the threshold through the module's own option, writes the state on the form's own drawn rule'. The bullet reads as a sentence left behind by the very fix build-findings.json describes (rulesOfPage minLength narrowed from 40 to 24 so this 31.25pt rule would be seen). It is unconditional, so one of the two sentences is always wrong: false for canonical, where the state is printed, and true only for the boundary case where 'Colorado' spelled out is refused as unfittable. A participant told to hand-write a state onto a proposed order that already reads 'CO' writes over correct data on the document the judge signs. Repair is in the guide generator, not in the overlay geometry: make both sentences conditional on the recorded refusal for the fixture being described.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: No ink at any protected blank, proven from the rendering rather than from the field map: pages 3 of JDF 683 and 2 of JDF 686 are pixel-identical to their pinned sources, so the petitioner signature and date, the lawyer signature line, the item 14 certificate of service and its date and recipients, and the judge-or-magistrate signature and order date all carry nothing. On the two caption pages 100 percent of added ink falls inside declared write rects, so the Division and Courtroom boxes are untouched. Recorded observation, not scored as a failure: the same court-use-only block also holds the Case Number line, and the packet does write the participant's own court-assigned case number there while refusing Division and Courtroom on the strength of the same printed 'This box is for court use only' label. I do not read that as a protected write - the case number is participant-held identifying data the clerk needs to route the filing, and omitting it would be worse - but the inconsistency in the family's own reasoning is worth the Captain seeing.

COMPONENT_SET.detail: The manifest names exactly two components and both are delivered: CC-DC-CR-072B (primary_filing, required, order 1) as packet page 1 and CC-DC-089 (fee_waiver, conditional on the participant being unable to pay the $30 fee, order 2) as packet pages 2-4. Recorded as a source obligation rather than a component miss: CC-DC-089 prints on its own face that form MDJ-008, the Notice Regarding Restricted Information under Rule 20-201.1, must accompany it unless the case is one of six restricted types, and expungement is not one of them. MDJ-008 is bound to this family by no source record, the packet does not carry it and does not stand in for it, and both delivered guides tell the participant to obtain it from the Maryland Judiciary. That is the honest treatment of a companion the manifest does not name.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: The 38 values themselves are correct, complete and inside their boxes on both fixtures. The FAIL is that the delivered records and the delivered guide state, three times over, that the packet wrote nothing on the court's order page while it wrote five things there. production-field-map.json refuses 18 fields on packet page 4 (CC-DC-089 page 3) and gives every one of them the same reason: 'page 3 of this form is the court's order on the request and every field on it belongs to the court'. build-findings.json says 'Page 3 of CC-DC-089 is the court's order on the request. Every field on it is refused as court-owned.' participant-instructions.md tells the participant, under 'What is deliberately left blank': 'Page 3 of CC-DC-089 is the court's order and every line on it belongs to the court.' In the delivered bytes that page carries five writes from the same field map: the DISTRICT COURT OF MARYLAND caption box is TICKED, and Court's City/County, Case No., Petitioner/Plaintiff and Respondent/Defendant are all printed. I read them off the rendered page 4 and counted their ink. The same refusals array contradicts itself in place - its first page-4 entry refuses the CIRCUIT COURT box with the reason 'the packet states the other member of this select-one', which is the tick the blanket sentence says does not exist. This is the participant-facing consequence and it is why it is a FAIL rather than a note: the caption on a proposed order names the court that will sign it and the case it will be signed in, and the packet tells the person filing that nothing on that page is theirs to check. Repair is in the copy and the refusal basis, not in the geometry: the caption is correctly filled and should be described as filled.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: Nothing is signed, dated or decided for anyone. Measured from the rendering: on all eight delivered pages, every added pixel falls inside a declared write rect, so the Party Signature and its Date on both forms, the whole Attorney Certification block, the Judge's signature, the Judge ID number, the financial-eligibility findings, the granted / granted-in-part / denied election, the ordered amount and its due date all carry no ink on either fixture. The order's 'submitted by (Name of party)' blank is also left empty even though the packet holds that name, which is the conservative direction. The five caption writes on that same page are scored under KNOWN_PREFILLS above rather than counted here, because the field map does not classify them as protected - it writes them.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.detail: This is the repaired obligation and it now holds, tested against the bytes rather than taken from the repair report. Stroke-only flattened appearances: 6 per fixture, down from the 56 VF20 scored, and each of the 6 is byte-identical to an /AP /N on-state stream in the pinned source and placed at that widget's own /Rect - the source's own X, not a synthesized square. The whole-page test is the one that would have caught the 50: differencing every delivered page against its pinned source at 130 dpi leaves ZERO added pixels outside the declared write rects on all four canonical and all four boundary pages, where each of the 50 squares would have been added ink at a rect no write declares. No value is clipped and none overlaps printed text, on either fixture, including the boundary fixture's long name, 16-character case number and two-line incident description.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: All three of MD.memo.json's selfHelpStopConditions for this track now print verbatim in participant-instructions.md, including the one VF20's superseded row found missing: 'The State's Attorney objects.' The guide goes further and explains that this condition arrives after filing and that the participant will not be the one who starts it, quoting rules.notice verbatim - 'The court serves the State's Attorney; 30-day objection period.' Four route boundaries are then stated separately and correctly labelled as route boundaries rather than record conditions.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The memo's destination is the Clerk of the District Court or circuit court that heard the case, and its filing rule is 'File with the clerk of the court that heard the case, on CC-DC-CR-072B with the pardon checkbox.' filing-instructions.md says 'File with the clerk of the court shown in the caption - the court where the conviction was entered - unless the case was transferred or appealed, in which case the form tells you which court takes the petition', which carries the rule and the form's own exception. Items 4 and 5, which the form says decide the court, are correctly left to the participant and are called out as the two answers that decide where the petition goes.

SERVICE.detail: The record's service rule is 'The court serves.' and its notice rule is 'The court serves the State's Attorney; 30-day objection period.' The packet asks the participant to serve nobody, invents no certificate of service, and states the notice rule verbatim. filing-instructions.md adds the petition's own printed victim notice - that a victim may offer objections or additional information and that the court may act as soon as thirty days after the petition is served - which I confirmed is printed on the source binary.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: All seven of the manifest's requiredBeforeFiling items are carried. Two print verbatim ('$30 (CC-DC-CR-072B).' and 'Request for Waiver of Prepaid Costs, CC-DC-089.'); the other five are carried in substance without loss - the signed gubernatorial pardon with its source and the instruction to check the pardon date before signing, the case-number check ('Check the caption, the case number, the arrest date, the arresting agency, the incident description, the offence and the conviction date against your own case record'), the signature and affirmation block, and the affirmation under penalties of perjury, which the guide states twice. Separately all 34 required-before-filing form blanks are disclosed with their printed labels. One recorded gap, not scored as a failure: the record names the free source for the case-number check, 'Maryland Judiciary Case Search', and neither delivered guide names it; the participant is told to check against 'your own case record' instead.

ARTIFACTS.detail: Both artifacts recomputed from the committed bytes: canonical 2bd8059f5970eab1ee8bb677e8006cd1a8557eba96b074b2c3eeea0d959172eb at 1,167,389 bytes and boundary a06f4ddabe754147bb8f2036d92583d5757d560aacbdd04b9deda6e55c68e3b4 at 1,167,835 bytes, 4 pages each. PAGE_ORDER.detail: Four pages in manifest order: CC-DC-CR-072B page 1 as packet page 1, then CC-DC-089 pages 1, 2 and 3 as packet pages 2, 3 and 4. Proven page by page rather than read off the page manifest - each delivered page differences cleanly against the source page it claims, which no reordering would survive - and the order page lands last, as CC-DC-089 prints it.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: Every selection the packet makes is defensible on its face, and half of them are hidden from the person who signs. The packet ticks four controls: (1) item 3's pardon ground, with the pardon date written beside it - disclosed in its own section of the guide, with the warning to check the date against the pardon document; (2) CC-DC-089's 'I request a waiver of the prepaid costs' - disclosed in one sentence; (3) the DISTRICT COURT OF MARYLAND caption box, on the petition and on both CC-DC-089 widgets, on the field map's basis 'the court of conviction held by this fixture is a District Court location'; and (4) item 1's 'I was arrested', on the basis 'the held case fact is an arrest rather than a summons or a citation'. Selections 3 and 4 appear NOWHERE in participant-instructions.md or filing-instructions.md, and the field map's own routeSelectionsMade array lists only selections 1 and 2. Item 1 is the one that matters: the form prints '(Check one of the following boxes) On or about ___, I was [ ] arrested, [ ] served with a summons, [ ] or served with a citation', the packet answers that select-one from an inference (factId null, routeDetermined false), and the petition is affirmed under the penalties of perjury. The word 'arrest' reaches the participant only inside 'check the arrest date ... against your own case record'; nothing tells them the packet chose arrested over summons or citation. Actionable repair: list all four in routeSelectionsMade and disclose selections 3 and 4 to the participant in the same terms the other two already get. Correctly NOT ticked: the other seven grounds of item 3, which the form makes a check-all-that-apply and which the packet carries as genuine participant elections with the form's own words beside each; and items 4 and 5, the transfer and appeal questions that decide the court.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: The packet writes no repeating row. CC-DC-089's three schedules - item 3 income by source, item 4 property, item 5 debts - are the only row tables, every row is blank on both fixtures, and each line is disclosed to the participant with what it asks for. No row states part of a fact, so no row index can disagree with the label printed beside it.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The contradiction VF20's superseded row found is gone. MD.memo.json rules.fees reads '$30 (CC-DC-CR-072B).' and rules.feeWaiver reads 'Request for Waiver of Prepaid Costs, CC-DC-089.', and both delivered guides now quote both verbatim and say '$30, keyed to this form'. The packet is candid about what the figure rests on: the two source binaries print no amount at all - the petition's only fee wording is 'Filing Fees Are Not Refundable' across the top of page 1, which I confirmed on the binary - so the guide states that the form is not evidence that the figure is current and tells the participant to confirm it with the clerk. The waiver route is not merely named: CC-DC-089 is delivered, its request box is ticked, its affidavit is left entirely to the participant because the platform holds no income, property or debt fact, and the guide tells a participant who does not need a waiver to leave the form out of what they file.

COMPONENT_SET.detail: The manifest names three required components and all three are delivered: CR-307 as the primary filing (packet page 1), CR-308 as the proposed order (pages 2-3), and the process_guidance instructions component as participant-instructions.md together with filing-instructions.md. KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: All 10 values are correct, complete and on the right lines, and the trap this family carries is handled. CR-307's AcroForm field names are shifted by one against the labels its page prints - the widget NAMED 'Defendants DOB mmddyyyy' is the caption's DEFENDANT NAME box - so binding by name would have printed the survivor's date of birth where the clerk reads their name. I checked the delivered rendering rather than the map: the caption reads 'Jordan Avery Reyes' on the Defendant line and 'Defendant's DOB (mm/dd/yyyy): 1991-04-17' on the DOB line, County 'Cumberland' and Docket No. 'CUMCD-CR-2019-01234' each under their own printed label. Every write is bound to the printed label the widget was measured against and reports/caption-evidence.json carries the correspondence.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: CR-308 is the order the judge signs and the packet says so - participant-instructions.md tells the participant that everything on it except the caption belongs to the judge, and reports/blanks.json refuses each ordering box as 'an ordering box on the order the judge signs'. The delivered bytes stamp a synthesized square at all three of them: the 'State consents, GRANTED without a hearing' box, the 'hearing was held, GRANTED' box and the 'hearing was held, DENIED' box. No text is written and no judge's signature is forged, so nothing on the order is decided - but ink this build added sits on three of the court's own decision controls, on a document the court will sign, and the packet's own record says nothing there is its to touch. The prosecutor's name, both hearing dates, the findings-of-fact box and the judge's signature line all carry no ink, and page 3 of the packet is pixel-identical to its source page. This failure and CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP have one cause and one repair.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.detail: NINE SYNTHESIZED CHECK-BOX OUTLINES PER FIXTURE, on both fixtures - the same defect class that failed md_pardon_expungement (56) and co_petition_seal_arrest (7), arriving on a family that already holds a RASTER_PASS. The mechanism is the documented one and I confirmed it in the source: every check box on both Maine forms carries /AS /Off with an /AP /N dictionary that holds an /On entry and NO /Off entry, and /MK << /CA (8) >> with no /BC border colour. Under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing at such a widget; pdf-lib's default check-box provider invents a stroked square the size of the widget /Rect, and the flatten stamps it onto the page. Proof, from the delivered bytes rather than from any report: 9 stroke-only flattened appearances, 3 on packet page 1 and 6 on page 2, each stream a bare rectangle outline; NONE of the nine matches any /AP /N stream in either pinned source (I ran the same byte comparison that matched all six of Maryland's marks to their source appearances); and pixel differencing every delivered page against its pinned source leaves 445 added pixels per fixture outside every declared write rect, every one of them inside a check-box rect - 135 at the three CR-307 court boxes, 135 at the three CR-308 court boxes, and 67 + 63 + 45 at the three CR-308 ordering boxes. Visually it is the co_petition_seal_arrest shape: the invented ring lands around the box the form already prints, so the participant sees a doubled, heavier outline where Maine prints one. Measured on the 'Superior Court' box, source ink 174 pixels and delivered ink 249 in the same window, with the ink extent growing only 0.6pt in width - which is exactly why a bounding-box test cannot see it and why the brief told me to render. Every other value is inside its box and nothing is clipped; this obligation fails on the added ink alone.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: This is the most sensitive route in the sprint and its participant copy carries almost none of the boundary its own record states. The track record lists SEVEN selfHelpStopConditions; not one appears verbatim in participant-instructions.md or filing-instructions.md, and only one appears in substance ('If the State opposes, or the court sets a contested hearing, automated assistance ends and you need a lawyer'). Absent entirely, with their key words absent too - I searched both files case-insensitively for advocate, legal aid, legal-aid, victim services, referral, assess and immigration and every one returns nothing: (1) 'This entire track is a self-help boundary at the assessment stage. An attorney, legal-aid provider or qualified victim-services advocate must assess the case before any packet is prepared, and the referral must be named before the track opens.' (2) 'Any immigration-adjacent case ... sealing does not bind federal authorities' - which the record explains is common on this route because the statute contemplates federal immigration certifications as documentation. (3) 'Any decision about what documentation to present or whether to trigger the sec. 2264(4-A)(B) presumption.' (4) 'Any decision about whether to seek the State's consent so the motion can be granted without a hearing' - while filing-instructions.md affirmatively points the participant at the consent route ('CR-308's first ordering box is the no-hearing route') without saying that choosing it is a lawyer's call. Both scopeRestrictions are absent as well, including 'Do not open this track without a named legal-aid or victim-services referral partner in place.' Also absent: the record's legalDesignLimitations instruction that participant copy must say sealing restricts what agencies may disseminate and what appears on a State Bureau of Identification check - 'State Bureau of Identification' appears nowhere in the guide - and any statement of the durability rule. On that last point the packet hands the participant a proposed order whose page 2 prints 'WARNING: If at any time after the date of this order the Defendant is convicted of a new crime in Maine or in any other jurisdiction, the new conviction extinguishes this order', which I read in the delivered bytes, while the controlling record says 15 M.R.S. sec. 2264(7) as amended by PL 2025, c. 513 exempts sec. 2262-B records from that rule and describes LegalEase's position as 'the packet states the statutory rule, does not repeat the form's warning as advice'. The packet states no rule at all and says nothing about the conflict, so a survivor reads the form's warning as the law.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The record's venue is the court in which the conviction was entered, in the underlying criminal proceeding under sec. 2264(1), with consolidation where several motions are filed. filing-instructions.md states exactly that, with the statutory cite and the consolidation sentence, and names the clerk's office for the court of conviction. No courthouse address is invented; the court's town is carried to the participant as a blank because the platform holds the county and not the town.

SERVICE.detail: Honest about an unsettled rule rather than inventing one. filing-instructions.md carries the record's position - sec. 2264(3) directs notice to the prosecutorial office, no service obligation is imposed on the movant by the statute or by CR-307, and the form carries no certificate-of-service block - then says in terms that whether the participant serves the prosecutor or the court performs all notice is not settled in the committed record, and to ask the clerk. No certificate of service is invented and none is filled. The build's own findings carry the same question as an open source-acquisition gate, me_2264_7_prosecutor_notice_method.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The four form blanks the family classifies as required-before-filing are all disclosed with their printed labels, and that part is done properly. What is missing is most of the record's own participant-action list. The manifest carries eleven requiredBeforeFiling strings and three obtain_document actions, and the delivered copy carries none of the following, checked by keyword search over both files: 'Obtain Certified copy of the judgment and docket record for each conviction' and the requiredBeforeFiling:true confirm that goes with it, 'Check your answer to "What crime were you convicted of, as it is named on the judgment?" against Certified copy of the judgment and docket record ... and correct the packet if they disagree' - the words certified and docket record appear nowhere; 'Obtain Official documentation of victim status, if the participant already holds any', which sec. 2264(4-A)(B) makes a presumption trigger - the words documentation and presumption appear nowhere; 'Obtain Affidavit or sworn testimony from clergy, a medical professional, victim services staff, or another professional' - the word affidavit appears nowhere; and 'The hearing date, time and courtroom, where a hearing is set' - the word courtroom appears nowhere. The guide does quote CR-307 paragraph 2 and say what signing it asserts, which is the single most important thing on the form and is done well. But a participant on this route is told nothing about the supporting material the statute is built around, and the record's own answer for what documentation to present is that it is a lawyer's decision - which the packet also does not say. Actionable repair: carry the manifest's participant-action list into the guide the way the Colorado and Maryland packets carry theirs.

The RASTER_PASS in product-wiring.json binds boundToCanonicalSha256 0ee66d97..., the same digest, so the raster was admitted against exactly these bytes - which is worth stating plainly, because these are the bytes that carry the nine synthesized squares.

PAGE_ORDER.detail: Three pages in manifest order: CR-307 page 1, then CR-308 pages 1 and 2, motion before proposed order. Proven page by page - each delivered page differences cleanly against the source page it claims, with 0 removed pixels everywhere, which no reordering would survive.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: No option is answered and none should be. The three court-for-filing boxes are the participant's: the route reaches Superior Court, District Court and the Unified Criminal Docket alike, so the packet cannot pick one, and the guide prints the form's own instruction ('X' the court for filing) with all three named and tells the participant to mark the court their conviction was entered in. The three CR-308 ordering boxes are the judge's and are listed as such. No mark is made at any of the nine - the ink stamped there is a synthesized empty outline, not a tick, and I checked that no X, check glyph or diagonal stroke is present anywhere in the delivered bytes. CR-307 item 2, the survivor averment, has no widget behind it at all; the guide quotes it and states what signing it asserts.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: Measured and does not apply: neither form carries a repeating row table. CR-308's findings-of-fact area is a single multi-line text field, left entirely to the court, so no row states part of a fact.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The record says no fee is expected on the strength of Administrative Order JB-05-26, which lists no fee for a criminal post-judgment motion, and that no waiver is expected because no fee is expected. filing-instructions.md carries exactly that, states no amount, and tells the participant to ask the clerk. It correctly does not promise a refund and does not send the participant to the civil in-forma-pauperis forms, which the record names as a specific error to avoid. No fee, waiver or deadline is fabricated.

crossChecks.malformedAppearanceStreamInThePublishedS: Confirmed as the source's own defect, not the build's, and I checked it rather than accepting it. In the pinned CR-308 (through its proved-equivalent derivative) the field 'Findings of fact supporting this ORDER are as follows 1' carries an /AP /N stream whose dictionary holds /BBox, /Filter, /Length and /Resources and NO /Subtype and no /Type, while every other field on the same form carries /Type /XObject /Subtype /Form. Flattening promotes that stream to a page-level XObject, where /Subtype is required, so poppler emits 'Syntax Error: XObject subtype is missing or wrong type'. I reproduced the asymmetry: pdftotext over the official CR-308 and over the pikepdf derivative is silent, and the same command over the delivered canonical.pdf raises the warning. The page still renders - packet page 3 differs from its source page by exactly 0 pixels - so this is not a reason to fail the family and I do not score it. Worth saying to whoever owns the flattener: stamping /Type /XObject /Subtype /Form onto an appearance stream as it is promoted to a page XObject would silence it without touching a single mark the Maine Judicial Branch authored.
crossChecks.clonedFamilyPackets: CLONED_FAMILY_PACKETS.json names no Maine family in any cloned, near-clone or shared-document group, and this family appears nowhere in it. The sibling me-seal-gen-set is the general sealing route on different forms.
crossChecks.defectsNoCounterCanSee: Aliases on a name line: not present. AcroForm index versus printed label: this family carries the strongest instance of that defect class in the sources I have read today - CR-307's field names are shifted by one against its printed labels - and the build defeats it by measurement; I verified the result on the rendered page rather than in the map. Internal record text on a filing: none reaches the PDFs. Published zero where a measurement existed: addedGlyphsReadFromOutputBytes is a real reading here (85 and 55 canonical, 229 and 107 boundary). Geometry-counter blind spot: this family is the proof of the brief's warning. nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes reads 0 on all four documents and is TRUE - the strays draw no glyph - while nine invented squares per fixture sit on the paper. The pixel difference found them in one pass.

visualDefects.defect: Nine synthesized stroked check-box outlines, one per check-box widget, on both fixtures: three at CR-307's Superior Court / Unified Criminal Docket / District Court boxes (packet page 1) and six on CR-308 (packet page 2) - its three court boxes and its three GRANTED/GRANTED/DENIED ordering boxes.
visualDefects.causedBy: pdf-lib's default check-box appearance provider regenerating an appearance for a widget whose /AS /Off state has no /AP /N /Off entry, followed by the flatten stamping the invention onto the page. Every Maine check box on both forms is in that state.
visualDefects.provenNotSource: none of the nine streams matches any /AP /N appearance stream in either pinned source; the same comparison matched all six of md_pardon_expungement's marks to their source appearances byte for byte.
visualDefects.whereItLands: around the box the form already prints, producing a doubled and heavier outline rather than a stray square in white space - which is why the ink extent grows by less than a point and a bounding-box test cannot see it.
visualDefects.worstInstance: three of the nine are on the order the judge signs, at the controls the court ticks to grant or deny the motion.
visualDefects.seenIn: both canonical and boundary, 445 added pixels per fixture at 120 dpi.

rows.grantsNothing: This is an independent read of two rendered fixtures. It approves no output, promotes no route and opens no commercial path. The family is in any case delivery-gated by two open source-acquisition gates its own build declares, and this FAIL is about the packet, not about those gates.
